content: Back Translation can improve the estimate conditional probability of the target word on the previous context words through adding a bilingual data with approximate translations to the source languages. Furthermore, the synthetic data might contain some translation noise from the Back Translation system, and if this noise is relevant, our NMT can be more robust in learning how to translate noisy inputs. One the other hand, if the quality of the Back Translation system is not adequate, using the synthesis data might bring adverse effects to our NMT.
